title: Mumcord plugin manifest
description: manifest.json at the root of a .mcplugin package (format 1, plugin API 1.x, at most 16 KiB). Unknown fields are ignored by the app; the app's parser in crates/plugins is the reference. Rules the schema cannot express: a permission appears only once across required and optional; commands need the permission "commands"; triggers need the permission "chat.triggers" and are unique; chat_patterns need the permission "chat.patterns", must be anchored at the message start (^ or \A, not in multi-line mode), must compile in Rust's regex crate within its size limits and are unique; net.hosts and the permission "net.http" go together; net.http and secrets are only available to official plugins; since API 1.1 each of the fields net.origins, app_menu, stage, webview and audio needs its permission (net.origins, ui.app-menu, ui.stage, ui.webview, audio.effects), and the permissions ui.stage, ui.side-panel, ui.app-menu, net.origins, peers.relay, audio.effects, files.save, chat.post-image and files.import-picture need api ^1.1; ids starting with mumcord- or core- are reserved for official plugins.

id.description: Plugin id; the prefixes mumcord- and core- are reserved.

name.description: Display name in English; i18n/<lang>.json may translate it with the key manifest.name.

description.description: One-line description in English; i18n/<lang>.json may translate it with the key manifest.description.

version.description: Semantic version of the plugin, e.g. 1.2.0.

api.description: Caret range of the plugin API (mumcord:plugin) the plugin needs, e.g. ^1.0.

mumcord.description: Optional semver range of Mumcord app versions, e.g. >=0.7.0.

license.description: SPDX licence expression, e.g. MIT or AGPL-3.0-only.

suggested.description: Switched on by default in the install prompt.

quota_kib.description: Storage quota in KiB across both scopes.

default_visibility.description: Preselected visibility in the install prompt.

description.description: Shown in the chat box autocompletion.

triggers.description: Chat trigger words, e.g. !poll: channel messages in the user's channel that start with one reach the plugin as a chat-trigger event (permission chat.triggers).

pattern.description: Rust regex syntax (linear time, no look-around or backreferences), anchored at the message start, e.g. ^\[[^,\]\n]{1,64},. Channel messages in the user's channel whose plain text (line breaks as \n) matches reach the plugin as a chat-match event (permission chat.patterns).

description.description: What the pattern recognises, shown in the install prompt, e.g. Recognise EVE Online fits pasted in chat. Translations: key chat_patterns.<n>.description in i18n/<lang>.json.

hosts.description: net.http may only reach hosts the user typed into a form of this plugin.

origins.description: API 1.1, permission net.origins: the websites the plugin may reach (FR-9.23). Needs api ^1.1.

purpose.description: Translation key of the reason shown next to the origin.

app_menu.description: API 1.1, permission ui.app-menu: items in the Apps menu (FR-9.23).

stage.description: API 1.1, permission ui.stage: an activity in the media area (FR-9.23).

webview.description: API 1.1, permission ui.webview: where the web content may be shown (FR-9.23).

audio.description: API 1.1, permission audio.effects: sounds bundled in the package (FR-9.23, FR-9.65).
